subject.title: Add logging and warnings for cron job execution failures

question: Which public cron health/readiness contract should OpenClaw expose for failed, skipped, or overdue cron jobs?
rationale: The logging and cron-list pieces are bounded, but the endpoint/readiness semantics affect a stable Gateway operator contract and need maintainer intent before an automated repair lane starts.

options.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
options.body: Expose cron degradation through the existing health/readiness/RPC model without creating a new component-specific HTTP route.

options.title: Add Dedicated Cron Route
options.body: Implement `/health/cron` with explicit cron-only response and status-code semantics as a new public operator contract.

options.title: Ship Logs And List Warnings First
options.body: Add bounded runtime logs and CLI annotations now while deferring endpoint/readiness semantics to a later design item.

recommendation.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
recommendation.body: Expose cron degradation through the existing health/readiness/RPC model without creating a new component-specific HTTP route.

likelyOwner.reason: He left the latest detailed issue review and has the strongest recent cross-cutting cron/CLI history for this surface.
